capacity_handoff.rule: use exactly the single source named by the authorization; v3 is admissible only as the frozen transport-only recovery of a formally request-failed v2; no source selection from biological outcomes

selected_raw_photo_target: inherit exactly from the authorized capacity manifest; allowed values 100, 80, 60; no fallback

query.candidate_page_rule: rank all pages 1..min(50,ceil(total_results/200)) by SHA256(seed|inat_taxon_id|page) and take the first three or all pages when fewer than three exist

selection.reason_metadata_overlap_is_allowed: V1/V2 discovery opened no image pixels or colour outcome; actual acquisition is a new prospectively fixed query draw, while prior colour-measured experiment IDs remain excluded
selection.final_photo_selection: deterministic geographic maximin to exactly the inherited raw-photo target

execution.assignment: sort selected species by ascending inat_taxon_id then species; zero-based row index modulo 8

request_failure_policy.per_request_error: record and continue without retry or replacement

outputs.species_audit: all capacity-selected species with fixed pages, request errors, raw/eligible/deduplicated/observer-capped counts, geographic span and full-target status
outputs.candidate_photo_pool: exact selected-target metadata rows only for species passing the acquisition target; includes source URL for later firewall acquisition but no pixels
outputs.manifest: complete capacity-source lineage, shard lineage, request error fraction, full-target species count, exact target and fail-closed premeasurement decision
